entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker, reunited with her mother Pia, who confronts Baral, decides to say goodbye, and leaves for Amonkhet.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, a thopter engineer and renegade leader who now sits among the new Consuls.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's late father, remembered in a mosaic portrait.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: The scarred, imprisoned former Chief of Compliance who killed Chandra's father and tries to goad her into killing him.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Consulate inspector who has disappeared, blamed by Baral for the end of the inspectors.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The artificer who has escaped and whom the Gatewatch plan to stop.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who controls and perhaps created Amonkhet and is the Gatewatch's new target.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An elder dragon whose motives are less selfish than Bolas's but inhuman.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who welcomes Ajani into the Gatewatch and argues for going to Amonkhet immediately.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch, takes its oath, and advises waiting to gather allies before facing Bolas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who agrees that striking Bolas now is the best chance.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer who briefed the group on Tezzeret and Amonkhet and wants to act.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker from Zendikar who befriends Yahenni, shares the secret of planes, becomes more open, and befriends Chandra.

entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: An aetherborn who holds a Penultimate Party, gives away their fortune, and dies on the roof surrounded by friends.

entities.name: Depala
entities.description: Yahenni's best friend, a dwarf who dresses them and inherits their investment portfolio.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A friend who inherits Yahenni's Fleetwheel Cruiser and advises Chandra.

entities.name: Sana Ahir
entities.description: A nineteen-year-old human inventor who placed third in aeronautical design and receives half of Yahenni's savings.

entities.name: Consul Padeem
entities.description: A Consul who promises an impressive new Consulate.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: The inventor who has sworn her Planar Bridge will not be duplicated.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Rashmi's friend, to whom Rashmi swore the work will not be duplicated.

entities.name: Hixus
entities.description: Someone whose words about grief Gideon recalls.

entities.name: Crankshaft
entities.description: Depala's hyena.

entities.name: Skywhales
entities.description: Giant aether-sky creatures Nissa hears during meditation.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: Planeswalkers sworn to keep watch, now with Ajani as a fifth member.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: Kaladesh's government, reformed to embrace renegade interests.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: Rebels now part of the new Consulate leadership.

entities.name: Aetherborn
entities.description: Beings of aether, including Yahenni's family, whose life energy returns to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city of Kaladesh celebrating renewal.

entities.name: The Dhund
entities.description: Former secret Consulate prison compound being demolished except its core.

entities.name: Yahenni's penthouse
entities.description: The penthouse where Yahenni's Penultimate Party takes place and where Yahenni dies on the roof.

entities.name: The Aether Spire
entities.description: The tower where Nissa and Chandra meet on its platform.

entities.name: Aradara Station
entities.description: A station where Pia and Chandra arrive on their way to the mosaic.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane controlled, and perhaps created, by Bolas, which the Gatewatch plans to visit.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane whose landscape walks around.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's former plane referenced in her recollection.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: An aetheric chaos where Ajani once defeated Bolas.

entities.name: The Planar Bridge
entities.description: Rashmi's invention, now in pieces.

entities.name: Penultimate Party
entities.description: The pre-death party every aetherborn deserves.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The energy that makes aetherborn and connects planes.

entities.name: The Great Conduit
entities.description: The aether stream visible above Yahenni during their farewell.

events.summary: The reformed Consulate empties and demolishes the Dhund, freeing hundreds of prisoners, mostly mages and renegades.
events.quote: Hundreds of prisoners—most of them mages and renegades who had "disappeared" long ago—were released in the space of a couple hours.

events.summary: Ghirapur celebrates a new Consulate leadership that includes Pia Nalaar.
events.quote: One that included even "Renegade Prime" herself, Pia Nalaar.

events.summary: Pia and Chandra walk through the ruined Dhund to the intact core.
events.quote: Pia and Chandra Nalaar made their way through the ruined hallways toward the compound's intact core.

events.summary: Pia and Chandra visit the cell of the scarred, imprisoned Baral, who demands his execution and goads Chandra to kill him.
events.quote: "Baral." Pia said.

events.summary: Baral taunts Chandra about her father's death, but she refuses to be a monster and leaves him to be forgotten.
events.quote: "Screw you," she said. "I don't owe you a damn thing."

events.summary: Pia tells Baral that they leave him; Chandra leaves a jasmine flower at the cell.
events.quote: "My daughter and I leave you today," Pia said. "Stay and be forgotten."

events.summary: At Yahenni's penthouse the Gatewatch gather before the party; Gideon forces himself to smile.
events.quote: Nonetheless, even here where no one but his friends could see him, Gideon smiled.

events.summary: Gideon invites Ajani to join the Gatewatch, and Ajani speaks the oath.
events.quote: "Never again," said Ajani. "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

events.summary: Liliana's briefing on Tezzeret and Amonkhet leads the Gatewatch to discuss stopping Bolas, whom Liliana says controls and may have created Amonkhet.
events.quote: "Bolas controls the place completely. As far as I know, he created it."

events.summary: Ajani reveals he once defeated Bolas in the Maelstrom, warns against going to Amonkhet and asks them to gather allies first.
events.quote: "Give me time to get some of those friends together.

events.summary: The Gatewatch, except an unsure Nissa, vote to strike at Bolas now; Gideon decides to meet Ajani after facing Bolas.
events.quote: "Then we'll meet Ajani there...after we face Bolas."

events.summary: Yahenni, dressed by Depala, says they will not feed on others again and goes down to face their party.
events.quote: And I am not a killer.

events.summary: At the party, Yahenni announces their will, leaving half their savings to their aetherborn family and the rest to inventor Sana Ahir.
events.quote: "My other half of savings goes to you, red-scarf-wearing human inventor in the corner!"

events.summary: Nissa channels land energy to ease Yahenni's pain and tells them that aetherborn are the substance connecting the Multiverse and that she is from Zendikar.
events.quote: You are what connects the Multiverse.

events.summary: Yahenni gives Nissa a pendant necklace with a sapphire from Lathnu.
events.quote: Nissa holds out a delicate hand to take the necklace.

events.summary: Yahenni dies peacefully on the roof beneath the Great Conduit, surrounded by their family and friends.
events.quote: I dissipate into the endless sky above

events.summary: Pia and Chandra repair the mosaic of Kiran; Chandra offers to stay, but Pia insists she go and return, revealing she made shrines to both Chandra and Kiran.
events.quote: We can stop being a family of leaving, and become a family of arriving.

events.summary: Chandra tells her mother she is going to Amonkhet and says goodbye.
events.quote: "To Amonkhet. Someplace I've never been."

events.summary: Nissa, meditating on the Spire platform, hears skywhales and tells Chandra she lacks the words but wants to be her friend.
events.quote: "...your friend."

events.summary: Nissa guides Chandra through a calming river visualization and Chandra falls asleep; Nissa watches over her.
events.quote: Carefully, Nissa lifted Chandra's radiant featherweight

events.summary: In meditation Nissa witnesses a new aetherborn form from aether and guides them to the other aetherborn, hearing an echo of Yahenni.
events.quote: The aetherborn looked at their hands, then at Nissa's flowers.

relations.quote: For Chandra and her mother Pia, reunited after twelve years thinking each other dead

relations.note: Baral taunts Chandra about her dead father.
relations.quote: my corpse for your dead daddy's...

relations.note: He calls her a monster and has unfinished business with her.
relations.quote: "The little monster! We have unfinished business, you and I."
"We'd be honored," said Gideon, "to count you among our number."
My best friend's laugh is a little empty.

relations.note: Nissa is a friend whom Yahenni gives a gift.
Nissa asks to be Chandra's friend.
relations.quote: if you can be patient with me, I would like to be...
As far as I know, he created it.

relations.note: Ajani has faced and beaten him before.
relations.quote: I've faced him before. I've actually won .

relations.note: Baral blames Baan for the inspectors' end.
relations.quote: "It was Baan, wasn't it?" Baral growled.

relations.note: She joins the new Consulate leadership as Consul of Allocation.
relations.quote: "... The Consul of Allocation," Chandra intoned.

relations.note: Rashmi swore to her friend Saheeli that the work will not be duplicated.
relations.quote: the inventor has sworn to her friend Saheeli Rai that the work will not be duplicated
